fixture: frozen artificial 400x600 RGB; no real test Y or GT

tpost_basis.type: predeclared conservative allowance; not a measured fitting time or a proven runtime upper bound
tpost_basis.fitting_allocation: 120 seconds per level for all six train scenes, both A and B; four fixed levels
tpost_basis.A_static_work_per_level: 4097x256 gamma power table shared over 3 channels; 6x3x240000 pixel sufficient statistics and residual/bin passes; 3 two-variable NNLS fits
tpost_basis.B_static_work_per_level: 3 weighted PAVs on 256 nodes; pool and sort 6x3x240000 standardized residuals over 16 bins; 18 full 400x600 ortho FFTs; 240000 complex Hermitian 3x3 principal roots
tpost_basis.other_post_includes: native input decode and model initialization, all scalar image metrics, generated-cache and parameter persistence/hashing, final aggregation and reporting
